## Overview {.tabset}

Species listed in the
[Flora e Funga do Brasil (FFB)](https://floradobrasil.jbrj.gov.br/consulta/)
and expected to occur in **`r region`** were compared against the holdings of
the **`r herb`** herbarium to identify species that have not yet been
collected/vouchered by `r herb`, anywhere in Brazil. For each missing species,
the pooled occurrence records of the JABOT network (all herbaria, or the
subset supplied via `network_herbaria`) were searched for existing vouchers
within `r region`, to help prioritise where new collecting expeditions could
target these species.

```{r kpi-boxes}
htmltools::tags$div(
  class = "kpi-row",
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-blue",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value",
                        scales::comma(d$n_ffb_region)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label",
                        paste0("FFB species expected in ", region))
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-green",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value",
                        scales::comma(d$n_in_herb)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label",
                        paste0("Already in ", herb))
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-red",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value",
                        scales::comma(d$n_missing)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label",
                        paste0("Missing species (", d$pct_missing, "%)"))
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "kpi-box kpi-amber",
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-value",
                        scales::comma(d$n_missing_locatable)),
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "kpi-label",
                        "Missing species locatable via network pool")
  )
)
```

ggplotly(d$plots$family, tooltip = "text")

## Collecting Evidence

Of the `r scales::comma(d$n_missing)` missing species, the chart below shows
how many already have at least one voucher collected within `r region` by
another herbarium in the JABOT network (and are therefore easier to target
for a collecting trip), versus species with no known locality in the pooled
network sample.

```{r plot-evidence, fig.height=3.5}
ggplotly(d$plots$evidence, tooltip = "text")
```

---

## Candidate Collecting Localities

The map below shows JABOT network vouchers (from herbaria other than
`r herb`) of the missing species, found within `r region`. Each marker is a
specimen record; clusters expand on click/zoom. Use this map to prioritise
where to focus new collecting expeditions in order to fill gaps in the
`r herb` collection.

```{r leaflet-map, fig.height=6}
pts <- d$missing_pool_points

if (nrow(pts) == 0) {
  htmltools::p(
    "No missing species had a georeferenced voucher within the pooled ",
    "network sample for this region.",
    style = "color: #6c757d; font-style: italic;"
  )
} else {
  pts$popup <- paste0(
    "<b>", pts$taxonName, "</b><br>",
    "Family: ", pts$family, "<br>",
    "Herbarium: ", pts$collectionCode, "<br>",
    "Collector: ", pts$recordedBy, " ", pts$recordNumber, "<br>",
    "Municipality: ", pts$municipality, ", ", pts$stateProvince
  )

  leaflet::leaflet(pts) %>%
    leaflet::addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%
    leaflet::addCircleMarkers(
      lng = ~decimalLongitude,
      lat = ~decimalLatitude,
      radius = 5,
      color = "#1D4E89",
      stroke = FALSE,
      fillOpacity = 0.75,
      popup = ~popup,
      clusterOptions = leaflet::markerClusterOptions()
    )
}
```

---

## Priority Municipalities for Collecting Expeditions

The heat map below ranks municipalities within `r region` by how many missing
species already have a known voucher there, collected by another herbarium
in the JABOT network. Darker municipalities represent the best expedition
targets to maximise the number of new species added to `r herb`.

```{r leaflet-priority-map, fig.height=6}
muni_sf <- d$muni_sf

if (is.null(muni_sf) || nrow(muni_sf) == 0) {
  htmltools::p(
    "Municipality polygons could not be loaded for this region.",
    style = "color: #6c757d; font-style: italic;"
  )
} else {
  pal <- leaflet::colorNumeric(
    palette = c("#F2D7C9", "#E6B8A2", "#D98E73", "#CD5C5C",
               "#BC4749", "#A4243B", "#8A1538", "#1D4E89"),
    domain = muni_sf$n_missing_species,
    na.color = "#f5f5f5"
  )

  leaflet::leaflet(muni_sf) %>%
    leaflet::addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%
    leaflet::addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~pal(n_missing_species),
      fillOpacity = 0.8,
      color = "white",
      weight = 1,
      label = ~paste0(name_muni, ": ", n_missing_species,
                      " missing species with known vouchers"),
      labelOptions = leaflet::labelOptions(
        style = list("font-size" = "12px"),
        sticky = FALSE
      ),
      popup = ~paste0(
        "<b>", name_muni, "</b><br>",
        "Missing species with known vouchers: <b>", n_missing_species, "</b><br>",
        "Network records: <b>", n_records, "</b>"
      )
    ) %>%
    leaflet::addLegend(
      pal = pal,
      values = ~n_missing_species,
      title = "Missing species\n(known vouchers)",
      position = "bottomright"
    )
}
```

```{r table-priority, echo=FALSE}
mp <- d$municipality_priority

if (is.null(mp) || nrow(mp) == 0) {
  htmltools::p(
    "No municipality had a known voucher of a missing species within this region.",
    style = "color: #6c757d; font-style: italic;"
  )
} else {
  DT::datatable(
    head(mp[, c("municipality", "abbrev_state", "n_missing_species", "n_records")], 30),
    colnames = c("Municipality", "State", "Missing species (known vouchers)",
                "Network records"),
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
      "Table 1. Top 30 priority municipalities for collecting expeditions."
    ),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 15,
      dom = "ftp",
      order = list(list(2, "desc"))
    )
  ) %>%
    DT::formatStyle("n_missing_species",
                    background = DT::styleColorBar(mp$n_missing_species, "#cfe0f3"),
                    backgroundSize = "98% 88%",
                    backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
                    backgroundPosition = "center")
}
```

## Complete List of Missing Species

The table below lists all `r scales::comma(d$n_missing)` species expected in
`r region` but missing from `r herb`, ranked by the number of network
vouchers already known within the region (`n_records`) — species with more
known vouchers are generally easier to relocate for targeted collecting.

```{r table-missing}
display_cols <- c("family", "genus", "taxonName", "scientificNameAuthorship",
                  "n_records", "n_municipalities", "herbaria", "locatable")

table_data <- d$taxon_missing[, display_cols, drop = FALSE]

DT::datatable(
  table_data,
  colnames = c("Family", "Genus", "Taxon", "Authorship", "Network records",
               "Municipalities", "Herbaria holding vouchers", "Locatable"),
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = list(position = "top", clear = TRUE, plain = FALSE),
  extensions = c("Buttons"),
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
    paste0("Table 2. All ", scales::comma(d$n_missing),
           " species missing from ", herb, " within ", region, ".")
  ),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 20,
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
    scrollX = TRUE,
    search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
    order = list(list(4, "desc")),
    lengthMenu = list(c(10, 20, 50, 100, -1),
                      c("10", "20", "50", "100", "All"))
  )
) %>%
  DT::formatStyle(
    "locatable",
    backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(c(TRUE, FALSE), c("#dbeafe", "#fde8ea"))
  )
```
